metadata.title: Koperasi Desa/Kelurahan Merah Putih — sample location points
metadata.what: Stratified national SAMPLE (~50 villages per province) of candidate/mandated KDMP locations. KDMP is a presidential program establishing one cooperative per desa/kelurahan; each point is a village centroid, NOT a verified per-cooperative office location.
metadata.geometry_source: Badan Informasi Geospasial (BIG), Batas Wilayah Kelurahan/Desa 10K (RBI), geoservices.big.go.id — village boundary centroids, 2022-2023 vintage.
metadata.program_context_source: Kementerian Koperasi dashboard simkopdes.go.id/pers/dashboard (as of 19/07/2026): 83,381 KDMP with legal entity; 83,765 desa/kelurahan across 38 provinces.
metadata.sampling: Equal 50 per province (stride-sampled by kode_wilayah), so this is geographically representative but NOT density-proportional.
metadata.caveats: BIG layer carries no declared open licence and a note that it is not an official reference pending definitive boundaries. Attribute BIG; confirm reuse terms with BIG before redistribution. This is a demo sample, not the full 83k dataset.
